vr.look: A constitution is the written rules that set up a government. In 1787, leaders wrote the U.S. Constitution in Independence Hall, Philadelphia.

steps.title: Get ready
steps.html:
These are the models you will use. In VR, type the gray word in the Models search box to find each one.

@MODELS@

In VR, this page is on the Canvas tab too.

steps.title: Go in
steps.html:
🔗 First time only: connect Canvas at xr.optimaed.com. See Having trouble in VR? below.

Open the On-Demand app. Click Explore. Type Philadelphia in Filter environments. Click Philadelphia Independence Hall, then Begin Solo.

steps.title: Build the table
steps.html:
Find a table or an open spot inside the hall. Put the Community book in the middle.

Put the 2 quills next to the book. Put the clock nearby.

Put the Washington Monument at the front, for George Washington.

steps.title: Take your photo and send it
steps.html:
Open your menu, click Library, then Camera. Move the tablet until your whole diorama fits. Click Take photo.

Click the Canvas tab and pick @CANVAS@. Click Choose from My Files, pick your photo, click Use this file, then Submit to Canvas. Look for the green Submitted tag.

🔁 Want to fix it? Take a new photo and send it again.

steps.title: Check and leave
steps.html: Press the Meta button, then click Quit. Check that your photo is in the Canvas assignment. Not there? Open Having trouble in VR?

extra.html: Put the quills on the book, as if someone is about to sign.

vr.full: One photo that shows the table with all 5 kinds of models.

studio.title: Finish the Constitution Story
studio.look: Six sentences tell the story of the Constitution. Each one is missing a word. The word buttons are below. Some buttons do not fit anywhere.
studio.do: Read the sentence. Tap the missing word, or drag it into the blank.

doc.alt: The words We the People in big old handwriting

game.miss: That word does not fit. Read the sentence again.
game.done: The story is complete! In the United States, the power comes from the people.

sentences.text: In 1787, leaders met in a city called ___.
sentences.ok: Yes! They met in Philadelphia all summer.

sentences.text: A ___ is the written rules that set up a government.
sentences.ok: Yes! That is what a constitution is.

sentences.text: The Constitution begins with three words: We the ___.
sentences.ok: Yes! "We the People." It begins with everybody.

sentences.text: The country's power comes from the people, not from a ___.
sentences.ok: Yes! No king. The people choose their leaders.

sentences.text: In an ___, each voter gets one vote.
sentences.ok: Yes! In an election, all the votes are counted.

sentences.text: In 1791, the people added a list of their rights, called the Bill of ___.
